full_prompt_en: A square Fauvist-style landscape painting shows a winding garden path passing between dark trees toward bright fields and colorful distant hills. The path begins near the lower center of the selected panel, colored lavender and dusty rose where sun reaches it, then curves left and down through the greenery. Tall blue-black trunks rise on both sides, their canopies merging into a heavy dark green cover along the top. The closest trunk stands at the right foreground, nearly vertical and wide enough to divide the near garden from the open view beyond. At left, narrow tree trunks reveal part of a pale peach building with a small ocher roof. Around the path, dense shrubs and mounds of foliage are painted in saturated emerald, teal, orange, and deep red. Bright coral-red flowering or autumnal trees cluster near the middle and on the distant slope. Farther back, rolling lime and turquoise fields form wide interlocking bands beneath a blue-gray hill and a small pale cloud. The background remains open and sunlit, contrasting with the cool shadow under the near canopy. No person, vehicle, or readable text is visible in the selected scene. The viewpoint stands on the shaded path looking slightly down toward the valley. Sunlight enters from the right and distance, creating sharp warm patches on the ground and vegetation while the trunks remain nearly black. Thick visible strokes and simplified color masses replace small botanical detail. The overall composition guides the eye from cool enclosed shade through the curved path into a bright, chromatic landscape.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形野兽派式风景绘画呈现一条蜿蜒花园小路，穿过深色树木，通向明亮田地和多彩远山。所选单图中，小路从下部中央附近开始，阳光所及处呈淡紫与灰玫瑰色，然后向左弯下，穿过绿植。高高的蓝黑树干从两侧升起，树冠沿上方连成厚重的深绿覆盖。最近的树干立在右前景，几乎竖直，宽得足以把近处花园与后方开放视野分开。左侧窄树干之间露出一栋浅桃色建筑和小赭黄屋顶。小路周围密集灌木和叶丛由饱和祖母绿、青绿、橙色与深红绘成。明亮珊瑚红的开花或秋色树木聚在中景和远坡。更远处，浅绿与绿松石色起伏田地形成宽阔嵌合横带，下方是蓝灰山丘，上方有小块浅云。背景开阔明亮，与近处树冠下的冷阴影相对。所选场景没有人物、车辆或可读文字。视点站在阴凉小路上，略向下望向山谷。阳光从右侧与远处进入，在地面和植物上形成清楚暖色亮斑，树干则近乎黑色。可见的厚笔触与简化色团取代细小植物学细节。整体构图把视线从冷调围合的阴影，经弯曲小路引向明亮而色彩丰富的风景。
style_prompt_en: Fauvist-style painting organizes landscape through saturated interlocking color masses and visible loaded brushstrokes. Deep blue-green and near-black foreground shapes frame luminous coral, orange, lime, turquoise, and lavender passages beyond. Simplified trunks supply vertical rhythm; a curved pale band opens the view from lower space into layered rolling fields. Sunlit warm patches and cool canopy shade make the depth legible without realistic detail. Foliage is described as clustered color, not individually outlined leaves, while distant hills soften into broad planes. The overall effect is vibrant, decorative, and strongly spatial despite its non-naturalistic palette.
style_prompt_zh: 野兽派式绘画用饱和而互相嵌合的色团和可见的厚重笔触组织风景。深蓝绿和近黑前景形体围住远处发亮的珊瑚红、橙、浅绿、绿松石与淡紫区域。简化的树干提供竖向节奏，一条弯曲浅色带从下部空间打开视野，通向层层起伏田地。阳光下暖色亮斑与冷调树荫无需写实细节也使纵深清楚。枝叶被描绘成成簇的颜色，而非逐片勾出的叶；远山则柔化成宽阔平面。整体效果鲜明、装饰性强，即使色盘非自然也有明确空间感。
theme_en: A shaded garden path overlooking bright fields and red flowering trees
theme_zh: 一条阴凉花园小路俯瞰明亮田野与红色开花树木
name: Henri Manguin
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
